papers.abstract: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $\pi_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $\pi_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.

analysis.key_results: 在101个扫描校园环境（中位可导航面积104.87平方米、7个容器）中生成852个容器和超过68,000个抓取演示；最强个性化策略在目标场景达到62.5%的整体抓取成功率；在真实Stretch 3机器人上12项任务子集达到63.9%成功率，仿真对应66.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Splat2Act，一个自动化的real-to-sim-to-real流水线，将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略个性化到特定场景和物体集合，仅需手持手机扫描和用户物体的图像。
analysis.method: 利用3D高斯泼溅构建逼真数字孪生，自动发现桌面和非桌面容器，构建可行的抓取任务，并使用特权仿真预言机生成成功演示，随后通过两阶段微调个性化预训练VLA策略（π0.5）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Splat2Act提出一种自动化的真实到仿真到真实流程，仅用手机扫描和物体图像即可将预训练VLA策略个性化到特定场景和物体，实现物体抓取。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作在VLA策略个性化领域具有核心价值：专注于从真实场景扫描到仿真再到真实的自动化流程，用于微调预训练VLA策略（π0.5），实现机器人抓取操作。它直接涉及VLA策略学习、仿真到真实迁移和机器人操作，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models encode broad manipulation priors, yet adapting them to specific tasks requires balancing limited robot interaction, computational resources, and safety constraints. Noise space learning (NSL) adapts flow-matching-based VLAs by learning a context-conditioned distribution over noise while keeping the pretrained VLA fixed. Building on prior noise-steering methods, we formulate NSL as an interface for VLA adaptation that accommodates different learning algorithms and instantiate it with PPO, SAC, and AWR. Theoretically, we provide an information-theoretic analysis of how NSL enables efficient adaptation. Empirically, we study these NSL algorithms on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and four real-robot manipulation tasks under interaction, computation, and execution constraints. Across these settings, we develop a suite of effective NSL variants and derive practical recommendations for choosing among them under different resource and deployment regimes.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin和四个真实机器人操作任务上，开发了有效的NSL变体，并给出在不同资源和部署约束下的实用建议。
analysis.main_contribution: 将NSL形式化为一个适用于不同学习算法(PPO、SAC、AWR)的VLA适应接口，并提供信息论分析以及跨基准和真实机器人的实证研究。
analysis.method: 噪声空间学习(NSL)：保持预训练流匹配VLA固定，学习上下文条件下的噪声分布，并用PPO、SAC、AWR实例化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出噪声空间学习(NSL)作为一种通用接口，在冻结预训练流匹配VLA的情况下，通过学习上下文条件噪声分布实现高效适应。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于VLA模型的适应方法，旨在在有限交互、计算和安全约束下高效适配预训练VLA，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

analysis.key_results: 代码修复成功率从26.3%提升到31.2%；GUI任务完成率提高且平均动作减少39.4%；实验室规划得分从21.80%提高到46.01%；反应优化平均最佳观测产率达96.15%（对比贝叶斯优化的82.16%）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RSI-Anything框架，基于JEPA-Anything的预测世界模型，通过动作选择、学习数据选择以及条件世界模型自适应实现递归自我改进。
analysis.method: 使用预测世界模型指导动作和学习数据选择，观察反馈驱动策略或工作流改进，并进行条件世界模型自适应，通过组件和兼容性检查管理策略-模型对的保留。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: RSI-Anything框架利用预测世界模型指导动作和学习数据选择，在多个计算与科学领域实现递归自我改进。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于预测世界模型与策略的递归改进，属于世界模型和策略学习范畴，但未明确针对机器人操作或VLA。其方法论对世界模型驱动的策略改进有参考价值，但与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $\pi_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $\pi_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.

analysis.key_results: 在CALVIN上，D2R在想象中连续改进八个任务，平均成功率从63.7%提升至74.8%，而LoRA微调降至11.7%；使用π0和A2World时，D2R在LIBERO-90上学习未见任务并保持已有性能；真实Franka机器人上连续改进三个任务并保持早期改进。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出D2R方法，在持续学习新任务时，通过世界模型想象回溯来保留早期技能，无需回放缓冲区或新数据。
analysis.method: 利用冻结的预训练世界模型通过想象回放来锚定引导模块的旧行为，从而持续引导冻结的通用策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该方法通过持续引导冻结的通用机器人策略来学习新任务，同时利用预训练世界模型进行想象回溯以保留先前技能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接利用世界模型支持通用机器人策略的持续学习，与VLA和世界模型密切相关。

papers.abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.

analysis.key_results: 在服务批大小256下，标准解码加速1.20-1.47倍；在两个120B级模型上，吞吐量约为vLLM投机解码的1.8倍；分离状态精度降低了输出KL散度和下游精度损失。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ReplaySSM，通过展开递归将SSM状态表示为检查点和最近输入缓冲，从而减少状态写入、支持低成本投机回滚和输出专用验证。
analysis.method: 定期更新检查点，避免大部分步骤的状态写入；利用输入缓冲进行投机回滚和仅输出验证；分离低精度输出计算检查点与高精度递归更新检查点。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ReplaySSM通过分离状态检查点更新与输出计算，减少SSM推理中的状态I/O并支持低开销投机回滚。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于SSM的高效推理和投机解码，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略，但对采用SSM架构的VLA/WAM模型的推理优化具有直接的效率提升价值。

papers.abstract: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.

analysis.key_results: 在Llama和Qwen模型上，于WikiText-2、C4及零样本下游任务中，DUALQUANT在多数模型和格式上匹配或超过基于校准的SmoothQuant，显著优于免校准基线；在RTX 4090上实现Llama-3.1-8B的W4A4推理，记忆减少最高2.61倍，吞吐量提升最高2.46倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DUALQUANT，一种双尺度、免校准的训练后量化框架，直接最小化权重重构MSE，并得到逐通道激活缩放，支持包括MX系列和NVFP4在内的多种格式。
analysis.method: 将问题形式化为不可微权重重构问题，采用变量分裂和块坐标下降的高效求解器，每个子问题有闭式解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种免校准的双尺度训练后量化框架，通过最小化权重重构误差同时获得激活缩放因子，支持MX和NVFP4等格式。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于LLM的低比特量化，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界模型。但其提出的免校准激活量化技术可迁移到VLA模型的高效推理，具有一定的间接价值。

papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.

analysis.key_results: 在400个LIBERO回合中成功率达95.5%，每16步动作块推理耗时57ms、计算量2.3 TFLOP、GPU显存2.4 GiB；比教师模型快11倍，FLOPs减少18.5倍，显存减少3.2倍，且世界头仍能预测场景运动。
analysis.main_contribution: 从2B参数的Cosmos Policy提炼出隐式世界-动作模型SmolWAM，保留预训练主干并重建推理接口，在边缘设备上实现高效动作与未来视觉潜变量预测。
analysis.method: 保留预训练主干，采用单帧视觉潜变量、缓存注意力沉没的文本特征、28个Transformer块中的12个，以及1008个token，单步整流流读出击动作和未来视觉潜变量；训练耗时3.6 GPU小时。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SmolWAM，一种通过精简Cosmos Policy模型而得到的隐式世界-动作模型，可在边缘设备上高效预测机器人动作与未来视觉状态。

papers.abstract: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

analysis.key_results: 在100K上下文和并发128时，GLM-5.3配合DFlash2实现每个解码GPU 793输出token/s，是非推测自适应服务的1.27倍；在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上，500K上下文并发512时，Adaptive DHiSparse配合DSpark输出是非自适应服务的1.85倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 在分层稀疏KV缓存上支持DSpark和DFlash2等草稿模型推测解码，并动态调整KV常驻策略以适应负载变化。
analysis.method: 采用分层稀疏KV缓存，草稿模型使用窗口有界环，查询共享缺失行检索，验证暂存跨层组复用，并通过精确融合检索恢复所需数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Adaptive DHiSparse，在分层稀疏KV缓存上支持推测解码，并根据负载自适应调整常驻数据。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于长上下文大语言模型推理效率，不直接涉及VLA或机器人世界模型；但所提出的推测解码与KV缓存管理方法可为高效推理提供参考。

The resolver first takes rows that are in the tail or in optional history (1), then scans the hot cache (2). A row found in none of them is copied from host DRAM into the hot cache (3) before attention reads the selected rows. papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies issue sparse targets whose arrival at the robot controller is delayed and irregular, so a reasonable predicted action can still produce abrupt motion near people. Remedies are evaluated on different streams, delays and metrics. JitterVLA replays identical commands and arrival traces through alternative controllers, isolating the controller's effect. We apply it to synthetic reaches, hand trajectories from 20 people, three open VLA pipelines (838 episodes) and a physical UR3. Interpolation lowered modeled p99 jerk for every source, by 83% (615 to 106 m/s^3) on human motion with 200 ms delay, at a 2.0 cm tracking cost, and the effect replicated on 598 new episodes; jerk-limited generation lowered jerk further at a larger cost. Entropy-discontinuity associations had opposite, replicated signs in two pipelines, and entropy gating helped in one but not the other. On the UR3, interpolation lowered accelerometer-derived jerk by 3.0-14.0% in all six exploratory pairs, while a position-derived metric did not resolve the contrast. JitterVLA supports screening before human-centred studies; code and data will be released.

papers.abstract: Pre-trained robot policies, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, provide a strong foundation for generalist robotic manipulation, but adapting them to new tasks with only a few demonstrations remains challenging. Directly fine-tuning a pre-trained policy often achieves strong in-distribution performance, yet it can distort the representations learned during pre-training and weaken the model's generalization ability under out-of-distribution shifts. We propose Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment (RARA), a two-stage adaptation method, to address this issue. First, RARA retrieves representation features from pretraining with similar task intent and motion, and aligns the policy's representations of the target demonstrations with the pre-trained representations of the retrieved demonstrations. Second, RARA fine-tunes the policy on the target demonstrations while limiting how much its representations of the retrieved demonstrations change during fine-tuning. By reducing the representation mismatch before action learning and preserving pre-trained knowledge during adaptation, RARA limits unnecessary representation drift during fine-tuning. Experiments with Diffusion Policy and GR00T on 13 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboCasa, and on a real robot show that RARA improves the average success of fine-tuning by 9.5 points in-distribution and 13.6 points out-of-distribution, and outperforms all compared baselines. Project page: https://shua-kang.github.io/RARA_robot/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin、RoboCasa和真实机器人的13个任务上，使用Diffusion Policy和GR00T，RARA将平均成功率提高了9.5个百分点（分布内）和13.6个百分点（分布外），并优于所有比较基线。

papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.

papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) substantially improves planning performance in autonomous-driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, existing RL methods rely on scalar trajectory rewards that measure overall quality but fail to identify specific planning errors or provide actionable correction signals. In long-tail scenarios, errors in scene understanding, behavior selection, and trajectory execution are compressed into a single score. We observe that Reflective Guidance turns trajectory evaluation into explicit diagnoses and corrective instructions, substantially improving planning accuracy. Yet such guidance requires an initial prediction and its evaluation results, making it unavailable for direct single-pass inference. We propose Reflect-VLA, which treats Reflective Guidance as training-time privileged information and internalizes its planning benefits through Dual-Path On-Policy Self-Distillation (Dual-OPSD). Unlike scalar-reward optimization, Dual-OPSD uses the driving score only to route student-generated trajectories. It distills dense token-level corrective distributions from the teacher for risky trajectories while applying self-imitation to preserve reliable ones. To provide reliable corrective distributions on student rollouts, the teacher is progressively constructed through Driving-Knowledge Pretraining, Planning-and-Refinement SFT, and Self-Refinement Rejection Sampling. At inference time, Reflect-VLA generates trajectories in a single pass without explicit guidance or iterative refinement. Experiments on NAVSIM v1/v2 and Bench2Drive demonstrate competitive planning performance while reducing training time by over 90% compared with RL.

papers.abstract: Speech recognition on low-cost microcontrollers is, in practice, limited to keyword spotting or a fixed list of commands. We present O\'ido, an inference engine that runs open-vocabulary English speech recognition entirely on an ESP32-S3 (240 MHz dual-core Xtensa LX7, 512 KB of SRAM, 8 MB of PSRAM, 16 MB of flash, no neural accelerator). O\'ido executes a 13M-parameter Conformer-CTC model with int8 weights, per-frame dynamic int8 activations and int8 attention on the chip's SIMD instructions, with a schedule designed around flash and PSRAM bandwidth. On LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other the on-device arithmetic reaches 3.70%/8.23% word error rate (WER), within 0.12 points of full precision, and 3.33%/7.15% with an on-chip 1.3M-parameter language model; a transducer head gives 2.99%/6.67% and an int4 variant fits in 8.3 MB. This is 2.3-2.8x fewer errors than the vendor's recognizer on the same chip, and fewer than Whisper tiny.en and Moonshine tiny in full precision on a laptop, including in real noise and reverberation. Measured on a physical board, the firmware runs at 1.97x the duration of the audio on one core, with transcripts identical to an instruction-exact emulator: accurate, but not yet real time (a 4 s command is transcribed about 8.7 s after it ends). The two-core schedule gives wrong results on silicon and is disabled. A streaming variant shows partial text while the speaker talks and delivers the final text 4.1-11.1 s after clips of 3.6-10.6 s (7.2-22.4 s in utterance mode) at 4.86%/11.03% WER; a Spanish model makes 34-60% fewer errors than multilingual Whisper tiny. Code and models are released.

papers.abstract: This paper addresses the grid quantization error of deep-learning (DL)-based direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. Classification- based DOA methods discretize the continuous angular space into a grid, so that with a peak-based read-out, the accuracy and resolution are limited by the grid step and by the width of the label peak. To address this issue, we propose a sigmoid label that encodes the sources' DOAs as the sum of angle-shifted monotonic sigmoid functions. Differentiating the output of a CNN-Transformer network trained with the sigmoid label produces sharp spectral peaks at the source DOAs. Combined with a moderately refined grid step of 0.25 degrees, the CNN-Transformer with the proposed sigmoid label attains sub-degree accuracy and a 1-degree resolution, breaking the limit of the grid quantization error. Under the unified CNN-Transformer backbone, we compare the proposed Sigmoid label with the Gaussian label, the 0-1 hard label, and the binary cross-entropy (BCE) baseline. Numerical results demonstrate that the Sigmoid label attains the highest accuracy and superior resolution compared to other labels.

analysis.method: 使用CNN-Transformer网络，训练Sigmoid标签，通过对输出微分产生尖锐谱峰，网格步长0.25度。

papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) reveals versatility and convenience during VLM post-training, providing dense supervision for student from teacher. However, we observed an anomaly that the distilled VLM could still answer the questions accurately even when the related visual regions were masked or replaced with noise. Building on this observation, our quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that OPD, which uses the answer as a hint, has failed to teach students to genuinely seek out and rely on visual evidence. Our theoretical analysis suggests that this failure arises from a shortcut enabled by the lack of visual constraints during distillation. To address the issue, we introduce Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation (CV-OPD), which compares teacher distributions induced by positive and negative crops while conditioning on the same student prefix and augments optimization with a margin-based contrastive constraint, which is modulated with discrepancy gating across token and sample level. Specifically, CV-OPD first introduces a negative teacher unrelated to the answer and designs a Contrastive Divergence Loss (CDL) that constrains the feature distribution of student by contrasting the positive and negative teachers, correcting how the student exploits visual regions. The CV-OPD introduces a Discrepancy Aware Gate (DAG) that uses token-level and sample-level discrepancies to select visually relevant tokens for optimization, directing the student's attention toward visual content. Extensive experiments across a broad range of fine-grained visual benchmarks demonstrate that CV-OPD substantially alleviates shortcut and consistently improves the visual reasoning capabilities of existing VLMs.

papers.abstract: Memory-dependent manipulation requires a policy to track execution state and recover visual evidence that is no longer observable. We propose dual-stream memory for vision-language-action policies, assigning these requirements to complementary representations. A task-agnostic Gated DeltaNet compresses history into one temporal token, supervised by progress prediction and action-conditioned feature reconstruction. A task-conditioned retriever retains frames above a fixed relevance threshold; linear multi-scale fusion encodes each frame into sixteen spatial tokens. We then freeze the temporal compressor and jointly optimize retrieval and policy learning. Across sixteen RoboMME tasks, the complete model achieves 49.22% mean success versus 44.51% for the published FrameSamp+Modul reference, improving fourteen tasks and all four suite means. On four real-robot tasks, mean success reaches 62.5% versus 37.5%, with the largest gains on repeated actions requiring execution-stage discrimination. These results support combining execution context with selective visual access, while failures under cup swaps expose persistent identity tracking as an unresolved requirement.

analysis.key_results: 在16项 RoboMME 任务中平均成功率为49.22%，高于已发布的 FrameSamp+Modul 参考的44.51%，其中14项任务提升，所有四个套件均值均提升；在四个真实机器人任务中平均成功率达到62.5%，对比37.5%，在需要执行阶段判别的重复动作上提升最大。
analysis.limitations: 摘要指出在杯子交换场景下失败，暴露了持续的物体身份追踪仍是未解决的需求。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出双流记忆：任务无关的 Gated DeltaNet 压缩历史为单个时间 token，并通过进度预测和动作条件特征重建进行监督；任务条件的检索器保留超过固定相关性阈值的帧，并用线性多尺度融合编码为空间 token。
analysis.method: 双流记忆架构：冻结时间压缩器，联合优化检索与策略学习；在模拟和真实机器人任务上评估。

papers.abstract: Actions specify what a robot should execute, but do not describe what those commands will achieve. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies nevertheless learn primarily by predicting action chunks from images, language, and state. We introduce Action--Future Coupled Effect Learning (AFCE), which makes a future-grounded physical Effect the policy's primary prediction target. An offline tokenizer constructs temporally ordered Effect tokens from demonstrated actions, realized robot responses, and sparse visual transitions. Reconstruction objectives encourage the representation to retain executable detail and observed physical change. A flow-matching VLA predicts Effects from current images, instruction, and robot state, while a state-conditioned decoder converts them into action chunks. Embodiment-specific interfaces allow single- and dual-arm tasks to share the Effect model. On DexJoCo, AFCE achieves $50.97\%$ overall success, improving over $\pi_{0.5}$ and UVT by 11.82 and 15.21 percentage points, respectively. It leads on all five bimanual tasks, highlighting the value of Effect supervision for coordinated dexterous manipulation. The project page is available at https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/.

analysis.key_results: 在DexJoCo上AFCE总体成功率达50.97%，比π0.5和UVT分别提高11.82和15.21个百分点；在全部五个双手任务上领先。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Action--Future Coupled Effect Learning (AFCE)，将未来物理效应作为VLA策略的主要预测目标，而非直接预测动作块。
analysis.method: 离线分词器构造时序效应token，重建目标保留可执行细节；流匹配VLA从当前图像、指令和机器人状态预测效应，再由状态条件解码器转换为动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出AFCE方法，使VLA策略以未来物理效应为主要预测目标，并通过流匹配和状态条件解码器生成动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接改进视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的动作生成方式，通过预测未来效应来提升双手灵巧操作性能，与VLA策略学习高度相关。

papers.abstract: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen3 模型上实现 1.39 倍至 1.35 倍的端到端训练吞吐量提升，任务性能相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R)，利用稀疏注意力生成草稿 token 并通过全注意力验证，实现与稠密策略分布一致的快速 rollout。
analysis.method: 使用稀疏注意力提出草稿 token，通过全注意力验证和精确推测采样生成响应；草稿与验证共享同一策略参数；采用 KV-aware 调度器管理缓存。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出自稀疏推测解码方法，在保持稠密策略分布的前提下加速强化学习 rollout 生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于强化学习 rollout 的推测解码加速，未直接涉及 VLA 或 WAM，但其自稀疏草稿与全注意力验证的思想可为机器人策略的高效推理提供参考。

papers.abstract: World models enable large language model (LLM) agents to anticipate action effects and make informed decisions. For generalization, it is desirable for such world models to transfer efficiently to new environments with similar interaction structure and underlying dynamics. Recent approaches encode world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs, whose compositional structure in principle affords transfer, but still organize such knowledge around environment-specific objects. To address this limitation, we introduce RoleWorld, a symbolic world modeling approach which uses reusable prototypes and environment-specific parameter values as functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. From interaction trajectories, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a skill that guides the actor LLM to use role information in decision making. In a target world, without the teacher, the actor uses this skill together with its current role assignments and parameter estimates, and actively tests a role instance hypothesis through interaction when its uncertainty affects the current decision. Feedback from each action refines role assignments and estimates parameter values online, with no LLM parameter updates and the transition rules held fixed. Experiments on MARS benchmark show that RoleWorld enables robust generalization across environments with significantly altered object behavior, suggesting that functional role abstractions can serve as an effective component for knowledge transfer in world modeling. Project Page: https://future-item.github.io/RoleWorld.

analysis.key_results: 在MARS基准上的实验显示，RoleWorld能够在对象行为显著改变的环境中实现稳健泛化。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入功能角色抽象（可复用原型与环境特定参数）来组织世界模型中的交互知识，并设计了一套从教师LLM提取角色原型、转移规则和决策技能，到目标世界由actor主动测试角色假设与在线参数更新的框架。
analysis.method: 从交互轨迹中，教师LLM提取角色原型和基于角色实例的可执行转移规则，并生成指导actor决策的技能；在目标世界中，actor使用该技能及当前角色分配和参数估计，在不确定影响决策时通过主动交互测试角色实例假设，并利用反馈在线更新角色分配和参数，不更新LLM参数且转移规则固定。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: RoleWorld提出一种符号化世界建模方法，通过可复用的功能角色抽象（原型与参数）表示对象交互行为，实现跨环境高效知识迁移。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于World Model的核心研究，为LLM智能体提供可迁移的交互动力学建模，对机器人世界建模与跨环境策略泛化具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Scaling robot manipulation policies requires large amounts of diverse, action-labeled data, yet collecting such data in the real world remains expensive and difficult to scale. Existing methods either depend on human teleoperation, rely on simulation with limited visual realism, or use human videos that lack embodiment-specific annotations. In this paper, we introduce Grounded-Dreamer, a framework for synthesizing physically grounded robot manipulation data with video world models while avoiding human teleoperation demonstrations. Grounded-Dreamer combines the visual realism of generative video models with simulator physics engines. Starting from a small set of real images depicting robot task initial states, our method automatically reconstructs task-relevant objects and camera geometry, aligns them in simulation, and collects physically valid trajectories. These trajectories are used to post-train both a video world model and an inverse dynamics model, enabling the generation of visually realistic robot manipulation videos and corresponding robot actions from real images. To filter physically implausible rollouts, Grounded-Dreamer replays generated trajectories in the reconstructed simulation and retains only those that successfully complete the tasks. The real-world robot policies are trained solely on the grounded synthetic trajectories without any human demonstrations. Empirical results in real-world tasks demonstrate that Grounded-Dreamer can synthesize physically grounded data and substantially facilitate policy learning without requiring human teleoperation effort.

analysis.key_results: 真实世界任务实验表明，Grounded-Dreamer 能合成物理可信的数据，并显著促进策略学习，且无需人类遥操作。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Grounded-Dreamer 框架，通过结合生成式视频模型的视觉真实感和仿真物理引擎，从少量真实初始状态图像自动生成具有物理基础的操作轨迹，训练世界模型与逆动力学模型，并经由仿真回放筛选，最终用合成数据训练真实机器人策略。
analysis.method: 从真实图像重建任务相关物体与相机几何、在仿真中对齐并收集物理有效轨迹，用这些轨迹后训练视频世界模型和逆动力学模型，生成视觉逼真的操作视频及对应动作，再通过在重建仿真中回放生成轨迹过滤不可行样本，仅用保留的合成数据训练机器人策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Grounded-Dreamer 利用视频世界模型与物理仿真引擎合成物理可信的机器人操作数据，从而在不依赖人类示教的情况下训练真实机器人策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文为世界模型驱动的机器人操作策略学习提供数据生成新路径，属于世界模型与机器人操作交叉领域，核心目标是通过物理模拟增强世界模型，生成带动作标注的合成数据，直接服务于机器人策略学习，与 VLA/WAM 主题密切相关。

By combining generative world models with simulation-based verification, Grounded-Dreamer produces data that is both visually realistic and physically consistent. This simulation verification loop effectively filters out the physical hallucinations common in purely generative approaches, allowing robot policies to be trained directly on scalable synthetic data that transfers robustly to complex real-world scenarios.

figures.caption: The Grounded-Dreamer Pipeline. Given several real-world reference images, our pipeline first reconstructs physically aligned simulation scenes and objects. Within these environments, task data is automatically collected and processed with interaction-aware masking to fine-tune Cosmos-Predict 2.5 as the core data generation model. An image refinement model then synthesizes diverse initial frames by combining reconstructed assets with real scene backgrounds and object appearances. Conditioned on these frames, the generation model produces manipulation videos, which are converted into action trajectories using an Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM). Finally, all synthesized trajectories are replayed in simulation for closed-loop verification, filtering out physically inconsistent samples before policy training and real-world deployment.

papers.abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to track progress through an extended instruction, identify landmarks relevant to its current objective, and understand the surrounding spatial structure to act. End-to-end navigation policies typically rely on action supervision to implicitly learn these capabilities. Without explicit guidance on the evidence underlying each decision, however, policies can overfit to correlations predictive of training actions rather than learn the task-relevant grounding and geometry needed for generalization. Our insight is to guide the representations that connect instructions to actions: identifying what remains to be done determines which visual evidence matters, while understanding the geometry around that evidence informs how to move. We introduce GuidedNav, a unified framework that explicitly shapes these representations through training-time guidance. Subtask and landmark guidance steer native pre-action attention toward the active instruction segment and relevant visual regions, grounding action prediction in the current objective. Spatial guidance aligns the policy's internal representations with geometric features that capture long-horizon context and local spatial structure. Together, these objectives strengthen navigation capabilities while avoiding the inference overhead of intermediate textual reasoning and online geometric encoding. We also introduce Guided-R2R and Guided-RxR, two annotation-enriched navigation datasets that support more interpretable VLN research. GuidedNav establishes state-of-the-art performance among the compared monocular RGB policies, improving success rates by 8.1% and 13.1% relative to the strongest prior results on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, respectively, while achieving faster inference. Extensive experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness and real-world transferability of our approach.

analysis.key_results: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE val-unseen上，相比最强单目RGB策略，成功率分别相对提升8.1%和13.1%，且推理速度更快。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GuidedNav统一框架，在训练期显式引导策略的注意力和几何表征，避免推理时开销；同时发布两个注释增强的导航数据集Guided-R2R和Guided-RxR。
analysis.method: 通过在训练期加入子任务和地标引导，使预动作注意力聚焦当前指令段和相关视觉区域；同时引入空间引导，对齐策略内部表征与长程上下文及局部空间几何特征。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GuidedNav提出了一种训练期引导框架，通过子任务/地标引导和空间引导来强化视觉语言导航策略的表征，从而提升泛化性能和推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对视觉语言导航任务，属于具身智能中的视觉语言策略学习，与VLA相关，但未涉及动作世界模型或高效推理（如推测解码、量化）。

Together, these training-time objectives connect instruction progress, visual grounding, and geometry to direct action prediction along the illustrated route.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models and world action models (WAMs) have advanced robotic policy learning by building on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) and video generative models (VGMs), respectively. Yet VLAs learn without explicit supervision from future world states, while WAMs that condition actions on predicted futures incur extra inference cost and let visual prediction errors propagate into actions. We present Forward Dynamics Models (FDM), a family of robotic action models that couples action and future world-state prediction through an action-to-future paradigm. Future prediction is conditioned on action features, never the reverse: end-to-end training lets ground-truth future states supervise the policy through these features, while prediction errors cannot propagate into actions. At inference, FDM skips future generation entirely, avoiding its computational cost. The paradigm is backbone-agnostic, and we instantiate it with both VLM and VGM backbones. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate the effectiveness of FDM across both backbone families, achieving a state-of-the-art 99.4% average success rate on LIBERO and absolute gains of up to 13% over VLA and WAM methods on real-world tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上达到99.4%的平均成功率，真实世界任务中比VLA和WAM方法绝对提升最高达13%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种名为前向动力学模型（FDM）的机器人动作模型家族，采用动作到未来范式，将未来预测条件于动作特征而非相反，实现端到端训练并避免预测误差传播，且推理时无需生成未来。
analysis.method: FDM是一种骨干无关的范式，使用VLM和VGM骨干分别实例化；未来预测以动作特征为条件，训练时用真实未来状态监督策略，推理时完全跳过未来生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出前向动力学模型（FDM），通过动作到未来的范式将动作与未来世界状态预测耦合，训练时利用未来监督动作，推理时跳过未来生成以避免计算开销和预测误差传播。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA和WAM框架进行改进，提出一种统一的动作-未来耦合范式，在推理时通过跳过未来生成实现高效推理，同时避免预测误差传播，对机器人动作模型和世界模型具有重要参考价值。

figures.caption: Architectural comparison of action prediction and future supervision. (a) VLA predicts actions directly from the current observation and instruction. (b) A future-conditioned WAM conditions action prediction on predicted future video, requiring future generation at inference. (c) FDM conditions future prediction on context and action features through action-to-future learning. During training, action imitation and future prediction are jointly optimized; the future loss backpropagates through action features to supervise the policy. At inference, FDM denoises action chunks using only the current observation and instruction, skipping the future-generation branch marked as training only while retaining context processing.

papers.abstract: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders. Recent agentic systems refine scenes through repeated interaction, but they lack mechanisms to recursively extract actionable evidence from execution traces, overlooking which proposed symbolic edits survived, disappeared, or interfered during program execution. To address this, we propose VETR (Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement), a framework that enables agentic recursive self-improvement over executable world representations for symbolic graphics reasoning. Within each task, VETR retains aligned program/render records with bounded runtime observations and introduces an execution refiner that compiles observed writes and state changes into constrained alternative programs. The refiner validates their endpoints and preservation conditions against captured runtime state; the ordinary visual verifier then assesses goal relevance. Repair construction makes no additional language-model calls, but can require additional executions. Evaluations on BlenderGym (280 tasks) and BlenderBench (27 released tasks) with GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B show that VETR consistently outperforms existing refinement strategies, including BlenderAlchemy and VIGA. Controlled ablations evaluate the contributions of execution refinement and role-asymmetric evidence organization under fixed generator-interaction caps.

analysis.key_results: 在BlenderGym和BlenderBench上，VETR一致优于BlenderAlchemy和VIGA等现有细化策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VETR框架，利用执行轨迹中的运行时可观测信息进行递归自改进，精确识别和保留有效的符号编辑并生成约束替代程序。
analysis.method: 保留程序与渲染记录对齐的执行轨迹，引入执行精炼器将观察到的写入和状态变化编译为受约束的替代程序，并通过端点与保持条件验证，再由视觉验证器评估目标相关性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VETR框架，通过保留执行轨迹并引入执行精炼器，使智能体能够递归地基于可执行世界表示进行自改进，以提升符号图形推理性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于符号图形代理的可执行世界表示细化，不直接涉及视觉语言动作模型或机器人世界模型，但其执行轨迹验证和自改进机制对具身智能体的世界模型更新具有一定借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Recurrent-depth language models improve inference-time reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared network to refine internal representations, but the additional recurrent computation also increases inference cost. This overhead is particularly pronounced during long-context prefill, where the full input sequence is repeatedly processed across recurrent depth. Weight-and-activation quantization offers a natural way to accelerate this computation through lower-precision arithmetic, yet repeatedly applying quantized computation introduces numerical perturbations that accumulate along the recurrent trajectory. We systematically analyze how such errors propagate across recurrent depth and show that quantization errors introduced earlier are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps and therefore have a smaller effect on the final representation. Matched-budget experiments strongly support this prediction, showing that placing quantized computation earlier in recurrent depth consistently yields the best fidelity. Based on this insight, we introduce RAMP (Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision), which performs early recurrent refinement using low-precision weight-and-activation computation and restores high precision for terminal refinement. Across context lengths up to 4K, RAMP preserves near-full-precision prefill quality while achieving up to 1.16x end-to-end first-prefill speedup on an NVIDIA H100, corresponding to a 13.9% latency reduction.

analysis.key_results: 在上下文长度高达4K时，RAMP保持接近全精度的预填充质量，同时在NVIDIA H100上实现高达1.16倍的首选预填充端到端加速，对应13.9%的延迟降低。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入RAMP（递归自适应混合精度），在递归深度的早期阶段应用低精度权重和激活量化，后期恢复高精度，以减少计算成本并保持质量。

papers.abstract: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow rules from task-specific details. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework's infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation. Its 350 demonstrations are screened for completeness and task success. We then propose an agentic skill-induction method that inspects evidence on demand to produce reusable skills capturing workflow rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. When the same four execution models are equipped with skills induced by each method under shared execution settings, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates. Mean score improvements over the corresponding No Skill baseline are 4.67--10.54 points on MyPCBench Bounded Action and 3.11--7.50 points on a 286-task subset of OSWorld-Verified. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill.

analysis.key_results: 在MyPCBench上平均得分提升4.67-10.54分，在OSWorld-Verified的286任务子集上提升3.11-7.50分，均优于无技能基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Work2Skill框架，包括用于收集同步多模态人类GUI演示的WorkRecorder基础设施、首个用于可复用技能诱导的同步多模态数据集WorkDemo-350，以及一种按需检查证据的智能体技能诱导方法。

papers.abstract: Embodied agents must translate multimodal observations and user requests into executable actions while adapting to product constraints, changing goals, and execution feedback. We present JoyInside-VLM-Agent, a ReAct-style multimodal agent developed through product-conditioned trajectory construction and staged policy learning for robotic platforms and smart hardware. A closed-loop sandbox generates multimodal interaction trajectories covering goal revisions and failure recovery, which are checked against execution outcomes and semantic criteria. Supervised fine-tuning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation precede reinforcement learning with DPER (Dual-Source Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Token-Level Evidence Routing). DPER routes token-level evidence between a frozen privileged teacher and a privileged student sharing the rollout policy's parameters, modulating reward-derived token advantages while preserving their signs. Training rewards combine generative process evaluation, multi-judge rankings, and task-queue consistency. JoyInside-VLM-Agent achieves a BFCL v4 overall score of 77.44, exceeding the evaluated baselines; results on the other public benchmarks are mixed. On JoyInside-Devices and JoyInside-Robotics, the evaluated system, which includes domain-specific skill refinement, leads the baselines on all reported metrics. Two real-world quadruped case studies illustrate visually grounded search, replanning after execution failure, and explicit failure reporting.

analysis.key_results: 在BFCL v4上达到77.44分，超过基线；在JoyInside-Devices和JoyInside-Robotics上领先所有报告指标；两个真实四足机器人案例展示了视觉引导搜索、执行失败后的重规划和显式失败报告。

analysis.method: 产品条件轨迹构建、分阶段策略学习、带有DPER（双源特权在线自蒸馏与令牌级证据路由）的强化学习，结合生成过程评估、多裁判排名和任务队列一致性奖励。

papers.abstract: Decoder hidden states from different layers of large language models (LLMs) often encode complementary information. However, existing speculative decoding methods typically rely on a small set of target-model layers chosen using fixed, position-based heuristics. Selecting an optimal subset of layers is inherently a combinatorial problem, making exhaustive evaluation infeasible even for moderately deep models. In this work, we present a principled framework for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding based on two complementary criteria: informativeness, measured through matrix-entropy analysis, and diversity, quantified using centered kernel alignment (CKA). We investigate layer-wise Shannon entropy, aggregate entropy under hidden-state concatenation, and pairwise CKA dynamics across depth, revealing distinct geometric and informational compartments within decoder representations. Motivated by these findings, we propose entropy and CKA-based layer selection algorithms that favor hidden-state sets that are both highly informative and minimally redundant. As part of this framework, we introduce token-entropy filtering, which removes hidden states associated with low predictive-entropy tokens, thereby improving the quality of layer-selection statistics. In EAGLE3-style speculative decoding, our selected sets outperform fixed baseline choices, including the default $[2, N//2, N-3]$ rule, while providing a clearer explanation of why some defaults can remain competitive. Our results provide a practical recipe for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding, insights into the geometry and information in LLM decoder states, and a foundation for extending similar analysis to related applications.

analysis.key_results: 所选层集合优于固定基线（包括默认的[2, N//2, N-3]规则），且能解释某些默认设置具有竞争力的原因。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个用于推测解码的多层隐藏状态选择框架，结合信息量（矩阵熵）与多样性（CKA）两个互补准则，并引入token熵过滤。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出基于熵和CKA的多层隐藏状态选择框架，用于改进EAGLE3式推测解码中草稿模型层的选取。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for visual understanding, language grounding, and robot control, yet anticipating how the scene will evolve beyond the current observation can provide additional information for control. Action supervision alone does not explicitly encourage such anticipation, while future-image prediction entangles task-relevant motion with largely static appearance. To address these limitations, we introduce Evo-World, a lightweight VLA model that augments policy learning with future motion prediction through optical-flow supervision, thereby providing a task-relevant predictive signal focused on motion rather than appearance. We further design the training procedure to preserve these predictive representations during policy learning, regulating representation diversity while decoupling representation learning from action optimization. Across simulation benchmarks, Evo-World demonstrates strong performance, achieving a tier-averaged success rate of 91.1% on Meta-World MT50 , with a 13.0% relative improvement over the non-predictive baseline. On real-world AgileX robots, Evo-World outperforms the evaluated baselines across single-arm and bimanual manipulation tasks while using only 0.87B parameters and delivering lower GPU memory usage and higher inference efficiency. These results demonstrate that future motion prediction through optical-flow supervision provides an effective and lightweight approach to enhancing the predictive capabilities of VLA models.

analysis.key_results: 在Meta-World MT50上达到91.1%的层级平均成功率，较非预测基线相对提升13.0%；在真实AgileX机器人上，单臂和双臂操作任务均优于评估的基线，仅使用0.87B参数，具有更低的GPU内存占用和更高的推理效率。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise in robotic manipulation, yet their post-training still predominantly relies on trajectory-level supervised imitation over robot demonstrations. While effective for learning feasible actions, this paradigm supervises policies to reproduce expert actions at each step, biasing them toward demonstration-specific action paths and providing limited guidance for recovering toward task-progress states once execution deviates from demonstrated trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose OGPO, an Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization framework for recoverable VLA post-training. Instead of treating offline demonstrations merely as step-wise action labels, OGPO adaptively relabels trajectories with semantic key states and constructs goal-conditioned process rewards to optimize the policy for reaching these task-progress states. In this way, OGPO shifts VLA post-training from trajectory-level action imitation to key-state reachability learning, enabling policies to acquire a more robust ability to complete goal states from feasible off-demonstration states without requiring additional online interaction. Experiments on LIBERO and MetaWorld show that OGPO consistently improves VLA policy performance over standard supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, evaluations on LIBERO-Plus and our proposed LIBERO-ReAct, a mid-execution perturbation benchmark, further demonstrate that OGPO achieves stronger robustness and goal-directed recoverability under distribution shifts and recoverable off-demonstration states.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和MetaWorld上，OGPO相比标准监督微调持续提升VLA策略性能；在LIBERO-Plus和提出的LIBERO-ReAct扰动基准上，OGPO在分布偏移和可恢复的偏离轨迹状态下表现出更强的鲁棒性和目标导向恢复能力。

papers.abstract: Visual world models predict the consequences of actions from images, but planning with them is typically done by optimizers such as CEM and MPPI. However, these optimizers stall on long-horizon tasks where progress requires motion the objective does not reward, such as moving around a block before pushing it. This paper revisits kinodynamic sampling-based motion planning for world models, using the learned model as the propagator of a tree search in latent space. Our key insight is that the sampling strategies devised for high-dimensional search in configuration space apply directly to the latent space of a world model, where they rapidly expand through intermediate states that myopic optimizers never sample. We present two exploration strategies for the high-dimensional latent space, nearest-neighbor-guided RRT and projection-based KPIECE, with GPU-native batched expansion for efficient device utilization. We evaluate with an off-the-shelf DINO-WM on four simulated domains and a real-world block-pushing task. Our approaches match or exceed the success rate of CEM and MPPI at up to 13.8x lower planning time in simulation, and improve the success rate by 20% on the real robot.

analysis.key_results: 在四个模拟域和一个真实世界推块任务上，所提方法以高达13.8倍更低的规划时间达到或超过CEM和MPPI的成功率，并将真实机器人的成功率提高了20%。
analysis.main_contribution: 将运动规划中的采样策略（如RRT和KPIECE）直接应用于视觉世界模型的潜在空间，提出了两种GPU原生批量扩展的探索策略，显著提升了长时程任务的成功率和规划效率。

papers.abstract: Action-chunking policies predict future controls but execute only a prefix before replanning. How should a fixed action-token budget be organized to support execution? We propose LeapBot-JAC, which allocates sparse future-control references and dense execution targets within one shared action expert. Both chains are supervised by demonstrated controls and jointly denoised at aligned physical-time positions. Directed attention allows execution tokens to read reference tokens subject to the host's visibility constraints. JAC adds neither action tokens nor parameters and retains the host's world-modeling process; both chains participate in inference, while only the execution chain drives the robot. On LIBERO, JAC reaches 98.3% success with FastWAM and LeapBot-WA, up from 97.0% and 97.3%. On zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, their success rates improve from 53.5% to 70.4% and from 73.1% to 77.3%, respectively. RoboTwin and two real-world tasks provide additional deployment evaluations. Single-training-seed comparisons and FastWAM ablations support action-role organization as a practical design choice under a fixed action-token budget.

papers.abstract: In diffusion transformers, low-rank branches can mitigate 4-bit weight--activation (W4A4) post-training quantization (PTQ) loss by decomposing each weight into a low-bit residual and a high-precision low-rank component. Existing low-rank PTQ approaches, however, either optimize low-rank compensation and residual quantization separately, often requiring higher ranks, or rely on second-order weight updates without explicitly modeling activation quantization error, which becomes particularly pronounced under 4-bit quantization. To address these limitations, we present HSVDQuant, a unified framework modeling low-rank-assisted W4A4 PTQ as a coupled calibration problem and deriving optimization-based solvers from the joint objective. Eliminating the output-side low-rank factor yields a deflated Hessian that discounts residual errors already captured by the low-rank component, while an activation-noise surrogate is incorporated to suppress activation quantization error. Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 HSVDQuant consistently outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant in PSNR and LPIPS. It further surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on SANA-1.6B, FLUX.1-schnell, and FLUX.1-dev with an $8\times$ smaller rank and up to $6.25\times$ faster quantization. Furthermore, on the Qwen3-8B LLM, rank-4 HSVDQuant improves MMLU accuracy from 61.50% to 68.17% over rank-32 SVDQuant. Overall, HSVDQuant achieves better W4A4 performance with substantially lower rank and quantization cost.

analysis.key_results: 在五个扩散骨干上，秩-4 HSVDQuant在PSNR和LPIPS上优于秩-4 SVDQuant；在SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell和FLUX.1-dev上超过秩-32 SVDQuant，秩减小8倍，量化加速最高6.25倍；在Qwen3-8B LLM上MMLU准确率从61.50%提升至68.17%。

papers.abstract: The escalating size of pretrained neural networks has rendered model compression a prerequisite for deployment under stringent memory and compute constraints. With the irrational winding as an example, earlier work introduced a dynamic system (DS) paradigm that reconceptualizes compression as compact weight representation: high-dimensional parameters are encoded by the index of a trajectory produced by a dynamic system, from which the vector is recovered during decompression. This mechanism is fundamentally distinct from pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and low-rank decomposition. Along this direction, we prove that under a Diophantine condition, a finite trajectory of \(M = O(\epsilon^{-(d+\nu)})\) states in the irrational winding constitutes an \(\epsilon\)-net over the \(d\)-dimensional weight space, thereby linking state resolution, decompression error, and compression ratio in a predictable manner. Furthermore, we propose a generalized DS-based model compression framework by unifying four DS families---space-filling curves (Hilbert, Peano, Morton/Z-order, Snake), chaotic systems (Lorenz), congruential and pseudo-random generators (LCG, PCG), and low-discrepancy sequences (Halton). Also, we introduce the KD-tree and coordinate-template acceleration to scale to large models as well as outlier identification to control the error. Experiments on ResNet-18 and Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B validate that DS-based compression achieves competitive compression ratios without post-hoc retraining, with controllable decompression error and flexible state-space design, establishing it as a principled and practical compression approach.

analysis.key_results: 在ResNet-18和Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B上验证了竞争性压缩比，无需后训练重训，且解压误差可控。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出基于动态系统的模型压缩范式，通过轨迹索引编码权重，并统一四类动态系统族，实现可预测的压缩-误差权衡。
analysis.method: 利用动态系统（如空间填充曲线、混沌系统、伪随机生成器、低差异序列）生成轨迹，以轨迹索引表示权重，结合KD树和坐标模板加速及异常值识别控制误差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于动态系统（DS）的模型压缩框架，将高维参数编码为动态系统轨迹索引，实现无需后训练重训的紧凑权重表示。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文为独立模型量化/压缩工作，与VLA、世界模型或机器人策略无直接关联，但其高效推理技术可能为相关模型部署提供支撑。

papers.abstract: Edge language-model agents must hold a persona and reason correctly at once, in one context window that fills with history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy (persona-logic interference), and present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference ("What") from persona expression ("How") into two inference paths on one INT4 base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn and emits a verifiable structured state (Micro-State); the persona path renders it in character with the full history. In same-base-model ablations on an Apple M2 laptop (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, 4-bit; 480 runs: 2 bases x 4 pollution levels x 3 arms x 2 tasks x 2 personas x 5 seeds) we find: (i) the decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 (Llama) or 167 (Gemma) tokens while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203 on Llama, and its outputs are byte-identical across levels (40/40); (ii) the mixed single pass degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 to 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 to 0.150 on Gemma), mostly by failing to emit the required structured output (80-95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); (iii) with the same pollution fed into the logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (failure 0-20% vs 25-95% at L2-L4; paired $\Delta$ +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff's $\delta$ 0.50-0.85, Holm-adjusted $p \le 0.03$) but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on a topic's first turn (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms (warm median) without re-running the logic path. Code, logic-path adapters, logs and analysis scripts are released.

analysis.key_results: 逻辑路径提示长度保持恒定（Llama 180 tokens，Gemma 167 tokens），混合路径提示从242增长到1203 tokens；逻辑路径输出在不同污染水平下字节级完全一致（40/40）；混合单路径逻辑得分单调下降（Llama 从0.669到0.150，Gemma 从0.487到0.150）；逻辑路径在8B模型上比单路径更鲁棒（失败率0-20% vs 25-95%），但在4B模型上无优势；解耦增加一次额外解码（28.2s vs 18.2s），人格热插拔仅需1.7ms。
analysis.limitations: 在4B模型上，即使解耦架构，逻辑路径和混合路径都失效；未提供除中文摘要外的其他信息。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AO-DA 解耦架构，将‘是什么’（逻辑推理）与‘怎么说’（人格表达）分离为两条推理路径，实现在单个量化的基础模型上，使逻辑推理在长、误导性、人格密集的上下文污染下仍保持结构不变性和鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 设计 AO-DA 架构：逻辑路径接收核心轮次并生成可验证的结构化状态（Micro-State），人格路径基于完整历史将其渲染为角色化输出；采用一个 INT4 基础模型配可热插拔 LoRA 适配器；在 Apple M2 笔记本上进行消融实验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出一种解耦架构（AO-DA），将边缘语言模型智能体的逻辑推理与人格表达分离为两个推理路径，基于单个 INT4 基础模型和可热插拔 LoRA 适配器，提升逻辑路径对上下文污染的结构性免疫能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究专注于边缘语言模型智能体的逻辑与人格解耦及量化部署，不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）、世界行动模型（WAM）或机器人，因此无直接关系。但它提出的量化模型上分离推理路径、保持逻辑结构不变的思路，对未来在资源受限设备上高效部署具有推理需求的机器人策略模型可能具有一定的启发意义。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

analysis.key_results: 在四个大规模 MoE 语言模型的推理、编码和长时程 RL 任务上，TRACE 实现 FP4 权重/激活和 KV-cache 联合滚动，性能与 BF16 滚动相当，滚动速度提升高达 5.4 倍，最终 FP4 性能优于对 BF16 训练策略的后量化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 TRACE，一个针对 MoE 语言模型 RL 训练的 FP4 量化框架，利用滚动侧量化结果指导训练侧 FP4 舍入，并采用量化信息缓存方案降低存储和通信开销。
analysis.method: TRACE 采用滚动引导的量化感知训练，通过训练侧 FP4 舍入决策对齐滚动量化结果；并设计高效的量化信息缓存机制，选择性保留深层 mantissa 和 scale 信息。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 TRACE 框架，通过滚动引导量化感知训练实现 MoE 语言模型 RL 训练中 FP4 权重/激活和 KV-cache 的联合量化，减少训练与滚动路径的量化不一致。

papers.abstract: Expressive humanoid interaction requires speech, facial animation, and body gestures to form a coherent response. However, many full-body humanoid robots produce speech and gestures without a visually expressive face, while talking-face animation and robot gesture generation are typically developed separately. We present Talk, Render, Act (TRABot), an agent-based framework comprising specialized agents for motion-atom construction, dialogue generation, motion planning, and facial animation. First, to produce natural and semantically meaningful gestures, we construct Robot-Ready Semantic Motion Atoms by segmenting long-form, G1-retargeted BEAT2 motion into units with natural gesture boundaries, human-verified communicative functions, and feasible trajectories. Second, to preserve semantic order and coordinate body motion with the spoken response, we introduce a Semantic-Conditioned Compositional Planner. Given an ordered semantic function sequence and an estimated response duration, the planner selects approved atoms to realize the longest feasible action sequence while accounting for transitions and neutral recovery. Finally, we deploy a Streaming Face-Speech-Body Integration system on a physical G1 humanoid, combining streaming dialogue audio, audio-driven facial animation, and semantically planned body motion in a unified real-time interaction loop. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that TRAbot achieves the best overall performance among all compared conditions in terms of naturalness, expressiveness, and multimodal coherence.

analysis.key_results: 定量与定性实验表明，TRABot在自然度、表现力和多模态一致性方面优于所有对比条件。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TRABot，一个基于智能体的框架，集成了语义手势规划、语音与面部动画，用于人形机器人的多模态社交互动。
analysis.method: 构建机器人可用的语义运动原子；使用语义条件组合规划器协调身体运动与语音；在实体G1人形机器人上部署流式面部-语音-身体集成系统。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TRABot框架，通过专业化智能体实现人形机器人语义手势规划、语音与面部动画的实时协同。

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.

analysis.key_results: 在七种LIBERO-Plus环境变化下，PIVOT-Q在多个VLA骨干和量化方法上一致地恢复了性能，且仅使用全状态蒸馏7.4%的状态级蒸馏预算，在所有设置中优于全状态蒸馏。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了PIVOT-Q框架，通过脆弱性感知的在线蒸馏（OPD）选择性纠正量化学生策略在部署中遇到的脆弱状态，以恢复量化VLA策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
analysis.method: PIVOT-Q使用冻结的全精度策略作为教师，在量化学生策略的rollout中识别脆弱状态（基于短视界折扣累积动作差异），并应用阶段平衡的稀疏监督和行为锚点来避免不必要的改变。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了训练后量化对VLA策略鲁棒性和泛化性的影响，并提出一种选择性修正脆弱状态的框架PIVOT-Q来恢复量化策略的性能。

papers.abstract: Robots need to anticipate how their actions will change the world, since manipulation success hinges on the resulting contacts and object motions. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that predict future observations from shared features leave the forecast decoupled from the actions the policy will actually execute, and impose no physical constraints on how the scene may evolve. We introduce ForeAct3D, a framework for policy-grounded future world modeling within VLA policies. Learnable geometric queries decode depth, semantic segmentation, and camera pose from the policy representation into current and future semantic 3D scene states, and the future queries are conditioned on the policy-generated action chunk to ground the forecast in the planned interaction. A physical-consistency closure relates the two states through background staticity and instance-level rigidity, and anchors the wrist-camera pose to end-effector kinematics. These objectives shape the shared representation used for action generation during training, and no future prediction is required at inference. Without robot pretraining, ForeAct3D achieves 98.3% average success on LIBERO and an average task length of 3.73 on CALVIN, outperforming its base policy on every suite. Ablations show that semantic 3D supervision, physical consistency, and action conditioning each improve manipulation performance, and that action conditioning substantially improves future object localization. Real-world experiments on spatial placement, object insertion, and sequential manipulation further raise average success from 6.7% to 37.8% over the base policy. The project page and code are available at https://github.com/anthonytao80-crypto/ForeAct3D.

analysis.key_results: 在不使用机器人预训练的情况下，ForeAct3D在LIBERO上达到98.3%的平均成功率，在CALVIN上达到3.73的平均任务长度，均优于基础策略；消融实验表明语义3D监督、物理一致性和动作条件各自改进了操作性能，动作条件显著改善了未来物体定位；真实世界实验中平均成功率从6.7%提升到37.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ForeAct3D框架，将其集成到VLA策略中，通过策略锚定的未来世界建模、语义3D监督和物理一致性约束提升机器人操作性能。
analysis.method: 使用可学习几何查询从策略表示中解码深度、语义分割和相机姿态，生成当前和未来的语义3D场景状态；未来查询以策略生成的动作块为条件，并通过背景静态性和实例级刚性的物理一致性闭包以及腕部相机姿态与末端执行器运动学的锚定来约束。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ForeAct3D提出在VLA策略中锚定策略的未来世界建模框架，通过可学习几何查询和物理一致性约束提升操作性能。

papers.abstract: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. Evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems reveals a sharp improvement in Task success beginning with Claude Opus 5, rising from below 5\% to over 15\%, while substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remain. We further find that worlds that look better could work worse: better visual fidelity does not always lead to higher task success. This echoes the broader gap between perceptual realism and factual correctness observed in generative models.

papers.abstract: VeriContest is a benchmark of 1007 competitive-programming problems in Rust, each with a Verus specification, a judge-accepted solution, and a Verus proof. Its authors report that proof generation is the bottleneck for frontier models: given the specification and the code, the best model produces an accepted Verus proof for 13.95% of the problems on the first attempt. We report on solving the same proof-generation task with Rust-Prover, a verifier for Rust backed by Lean 4. The Verus specification and the Rust code are restated and translated into Lean, each specification becomes a theorem, and agents prove the theorems with Lean's kernel as the final check. All 1325 theorems of all 1007 problems were proved. 1259 of them were proved in one run of under 32 hours on Claude Opus 5.5, at a median of 3.2 minutes and $1.17 per proof, and 70% of them on the first iteration. The restated specifications were checked against the benchmark's test suites, and reviewed where no suite applies. None was wrong or weakened. The translated Lean programs were run on 21,413 of the benchmark's test cases and produced the same output as the Rust programs on every one. Across four Claude and four GPT models at five reasoning-effort settings, every current frontier model proves nearly all of a ten-theorem sample at every setting, and more effort raises the cost without raising the number of proofs. The cheapest Claude setting, Sonnet 5.5 at low effort, proves all of the 50 hardest theorems. We also rerun the benchmark's own Verus protocol with Claude Opus 5.5 on the 50 problems with the longest reference proofs. Opus 5.5 alone fails to prove one of them.

analysis.key_results: 所有1325个定理均被证明，其中1259个在Claude Opus 5.5上单次运行（32小时内）中证明，每个证明中位耗时3.2分钟，成本1.17美元，70%在第一次迭代中完成。翻译后的Lean程序在21413个基准测试用例上输出与Rust程序一致。多个前沿模型在十个定理样本上几乎全部证明成功，努力程度的提高只增加成本而不增加证明数量。

papers.abstract: Epidemic policy planning often requires coordination between geographical regions, taking into account mobility-driven spillovers and how to make use of limited resources. Existing methods either lack action-conditioned models of coupled dynamics or cannot guarantee per-period feasibility. We present EpiMind, a graph world model framework for constrained epidemic policy planning across regions. A graph-factored recurrent state-space model generates joint policy-conditioned rollouts from regional latent beliefs, while graph-temporal ADMM optimizes regional interventions, enforces shared-resource feasibility through projection, and evaluates temporal specifications under the learned model. EpiMind reduces admission RMSE by 29% relative to graph-free dynamics modeling, plans within 1-5% of the best feasible constant policy with guaranteed shared-budget feasibility, and outperforms all deployable baselines across three resource budgets in real-context evaluation. These results demonstrate that graph-structured policy imagination with explicit constrained coordination supports effective epidemic interventions from learned dynamics.

analysis.key_results: 与无图动态建模相比，入院RMSE降低29%；在三个资源预算下，规划结果在1-5%的最佳可行常数策略范围内，并保证共享预算可行性；在真实上下文评估中优于所有可部署基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EpiMind，一个图世界模型框架，用于受约束流行病策略规划，结合图因子循环状态空间模型和图时间ADMM，实现共享资源可行性和时间规范评估。
analysis.method: 图因子循环状态空间模型生成联合策略条件rollout，图时间ADMM优化区域干预，通过投影保证共享资源可行性，并在学习模型下评估时间规范。

papers.abstract: An external record may contain a procedure to apply or text to read, depending on the user's request. IBBench-Light tests both uses against the same record. Twelve semantic bases yield 144 matched pairs per model; four quantized instruction models produced 1,152 archived greedy responses. Paired exact-contract accuracy (PECA) requires both members to satisfy their output contracts. Qwen succeeds on 132 execute and 109 process prompts, but only 97 complete pairs, showing what marginal averages omit. We audit literal-target exposure and case normalization, then add 1,722 logged CPU generations to test directive-absent controls, twelve additional semantic bases, within-base wording changes, and generation stopping. In the pinned Phi rerun, changing the end-of-sequence (EOS) set changes exact paired success from 0/144 to 62/144. A bounded IHEval comparison uses the same SmolLM2 checkpoint and output budget while preserving its published instruction roles and scorer. The benchmark measures conditional task and output-contract success. Its task margins and paired count need to be read together with the stopping policy.

analysis.key_results: Qwen 在 132 个执行提示和 109 个处理提示上成功，但仅 97 个完整配对成功；更改 EOS 集合使 Phi 精确配对成功率从 0/144 升至 62/144。
